governor_mechanism_effect.description: Governor OFF vs ON, averaged over state visibility
governor_mechanism_effect.interpretation: Governor hurts decision quality by ~17 DG points on average

cognitive_state_representation_effect.description: BLIND vs AWARE, averaged over governor
cognitive_state_representation_effect.interpretation: Aware state slightly hurts DG on average (more info but model doesn't exploit it well)

governor_x_state_interaction.description: Does governor benefit depend on structured state?
governor_x_state_interaction.interpretation: No synergy established. Governor hurts in both conditions.

information_gap.description: Representation advantage of aware over blind
information_gap.interpretation: Aware condition has more observable information

cost_adjusted_utility.interpretation: Governor increases cost AND decreases utility. Not cost-effective.

conclusion: The governor's advisory recommendations systematically mislead the model. The governor increases trajectory length (more calls), decreases utility, and never produces a success that the no-governor condition does not also produce. The problem is governor design, not infrastructure.
